verdict.rationale: Store Sync makes a merchant's full product catalog accessible to AI shopping assistants so agents can discover products. However, the evidence never documents a developer-readable offer schema with price, availability, variants or checkout links. Access is form-gated, and it covers only US physical goods in USD, excluding digital goods, subscriptions and services. Missing for 10: a documented machine-readable offer/feed format, explicit price/availability/variant/checkout-link fields, developer read access for any listed product or service, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read machine-readable offer data — price, availability, variants, checkout links — for any listed product or service

citations.quote: Store Sync is for merchants who want to make their full product catalog and order management accessible to AI shopping assistants.

Store Sync currently supports merchants who are selling physical goods to US-based customers in USD. It does not support digital goods, subscription products, or sales to customers who are outside the US at this time.
It connects your product catalog and commerce API with PayPal's agentic commerce services, enabling AI agents to discover your products
